-- الصورتين مدموجتين داخل السكربت نفسه (ما تحتاج ترفع شي)
-- تنكتب تلقائياً بمجلد workspace وتتحمل عن طريق getcustomasset
-- لو تبي تستخدم رقم Roblox بدالها حط الـ ID هنا:

local BANNER_B64 = ""
local LOCK_B64 = ""

local B64CHARS = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

local function decodeB64(data)
    data = (data:gsub("[^%w%+/=]", ""))
    local lookup = {}
    for i = 1, 64 do
        lookup[B64CHARS:sub(i, i)] = i - 1
    end
    local out, buffer, bits = {}, 0, 0
    for i = 1, #data do
        local c = data:sub(i, i)
        if c == "=" then break end
        buffer = buffer * 64 + lookup[c]
        bits = bits + 6
        if bits >= 8 then
            bits = bits - 8
            local byte = math.floor(buffer / 2 ^ bits)
            buffer = buffer % (2 ^ bits)
            out[#out + 1] = string.char(byte)
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local function resolveImage(id, fileName, b64)
    if id ~= "" then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. id
    end
    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        if writefile and getcustomasset then
            writefile(fileName, decodeB64(b64))
            return getcustomasset(fileName)
        end
    end)
    if ok and result then
        return result
    end
    return ""
end

    pcall(function()
        local old = parent:FindFirstChild("CursorMGR")
        if old then old:Destroy() end
    end)
end

local function create(className, props, parent)
    local obj = Instance.new(className)
    for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do
        obj[key] = value
    end
    obj.Parent = parent
    return obj
end

local function round(obj, radius)
    return create("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)}, obj)
end

local function outline(obj, color, thickness)
    return create("UIStroke", {
        Color = color,
        Thickness = thickness or 1,
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
    }, obj)
end

--==================== بطاقات المؤشرات ====================
local Cards = {}
local CardStrokes = {}

local function selectCursor(index)
    S.Selected = index
    FC.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. CURSORS[index]

    for i, card in ipairs(Cards) do
        local selected = i == index
        card.BackgroundColor3 = selected and ACCENT_DARK or CARD
        CardStrokes[i].Color = selected and ACCENT or CARD_STROKE
    end
end

for i, id in ipairs(CURSORS) do
    local card = create("TextButton", {
        Name = "Cursor" .. i,
        LayoutOrder = i,
        BackgroundColor3 = CARD,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
        Text = "",
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        AutoButtonColor = true,
    }, GridScroll)

    round(card, 9)
    Cards[i] = card
    CardStrokes[i] = outline(card, CARD_STROKE, 1)

    create("ImageLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 42),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -21, 0, 5),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Image = "rbxassetid://" .. id,
        ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
    }, card)

    create("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 20),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, -22),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "مؤشر " .. i,
        TextColor3 = TEXT,
        TextSize = 13,
        Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans,
    }, card)

    card.Activated:Connect(function()
        selectCursor(i)
    end)
end

local order = 0

local function section(title)
    order += 1
    create("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = title,
        TextColor3 = ACCENT,
        TextSize = 14,
        Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
        LayoutOrder = order,
    }, Right)
end

local function slider(label, minV, maxV, defaultV, callback, decimals)
    order += 1

    local wrap = create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 55),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        LayoutOrder = order,
    }, Right)

    create("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 0, 20),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = label,
        TextColor3 = TEXT,
        TextSize = 14,
        Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
    }, wrap)

    local valueLabel = create("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 20),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = tostring(defaultV),
        TextColor3 = TEXT,
        TextSize = 14,
        Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
    }, wrap)

    local track = create("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 29),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 52),
        Text = "",
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, wrap)
    round(track, 8)

    local initial = (defaultV - minV) / (maxV - minV)

    local fill = create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(initial, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = GREEN,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, track)
    round(fill, 8)

    local knob = create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(initial, 0, 0.5, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 3,
    }, track)
    round(knob, 10)

    local sliding = false

    local function update(x)
        local width = math.max(track.AbsoluteSize.X, 1)
        local ratio = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / width, 0, 1)

        local raw = minV + ratio * (maxV - minV)
        local value

        if decimals then
            local factor = 10 ^ decimals
            value = math.floor(raw * factor + 0.5) / factor
        else
            value = math.floor(raw + 0.5)
        end

        local r = (value - minV) / (maxV - minV)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(r, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(r, 0, 0.5, 0)
        valueLabel.Text = tostring(value)

        callback(value)
    end

    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = true
            update(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if sliding and (
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        ) then
            update(input.Position.X)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            sliding = false
        end
    end)
end

local function toggle(label, defaultValue, callback)
    order += 1

    local row = create("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        LayoutOrder = order,
    }, Right)

    create("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.65, 0, 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.35, 0, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = label,
        TextColor3 = TEXT,
        TextSize = 14,
        Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
    }, row)

    local button = create("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 25),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -12),
        BackgroundColor3 = defaultValue and GREEN or OFF,
        Text = defaultValue and "تشغيل" or "إيقاف",
        TextColor3 = defaultValue and DARKTXT or TEXT,
        TextSize = 13,
        Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, row)
    round(button, 12)

    local current = defaultValue

    button.Activated:Connect(function()
        current = not current
        button.Text = current and "تشغيل" or "إيقاف"
        button.BackgroundColor3 = current and GREEN or OFF
        button.TextColor3 = current and DARKTXT or TEXT
        callback(current)
    end)
end

    LeftBtn.BackgroundColor3 = direction == -1 and GREEN or OFF
    RightBtn.TextColor3 = direction == 1 and DARKTXT or TEXT
    LeftBtn.TextColor3 = direction == -1 and DARKTXT or TEXT
end

--==================== سحب اللوحة ====================
local dragging = false
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPosition

Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = Panel.Position
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

Header.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input == dragInput
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        Panel.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPosition.X.Scale,
            startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPosition.Y.Scale,
            startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

--==================== فتح / قفل ====================
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function togglePanel()
    S.PanelOpen = not S.PanelOpen

    if S.PanelOpen then
        Panel.Visible = true
        TweenService:Create(PanelScale, tweenInfo, {Scale = 1}):Play()
    else
        local tween = TweenService:Create(PanelScale, tweenInfo, {Scale = 0.01})
        tween:Play()
        tween.Completed:Connect(function()
            if not S.PanelOpen then
                Panel.Visible = false
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- الزر ينسحب بأي مكان؛ الضغطة السريعة تفتح / تقفل
local lockDragging = false
local lockMoved = false
local lockStart
local lockStartPos
local lockInput

LockBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        lockDragging = true
        lockMoved = false
        lockStart = input.Position
        lockStartPos = LockBtn.Position
        lockInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if lockDragging and (
        input == lockInput
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        local delta = input.Position - lockStart

        if delta.Magnitude > 6 then
            lockMoved = true
        end

        if lockMoved then
            LockBtn.Position = UDim2.new(
                lockStartPos.X.Scale,
                lockStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                lockStartPos.Y.Scale,
                lockStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if lockDragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then
        lockDragging = false
        if not lockMoved then
            togglePanel()
        end
    end
end)

--==================== زر التشغيل الرئيسي ====================
PowerBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    S.Enabled = not S.Enabled

    PowerBtn.Text = S.Enabled and "تشغيل" or "إيقاف"
    PowerBtn.BackgroundColor3 = S.Enabled and GREEN or RED
    PowerBtn.TextColor3 = S.Enabled and DARKTXT or TEXT

    if not S.Enabled then
        FC.Visible = false
        pcall(function()
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
        end)
    end
end)

--==================== إخفاء مؤشرات اللعبة تلقائياً ====================
local tracked = {}
local hideKeywords = {
    "cursor",
    "mouseicon",
    "shiftlockcursor",
    "centerlock",
    "crosshair",
}

local function isOurGui(obj)
    return obj == Root or obj:IsDescendantOf(Root)
end

local function inspectElement(obj)
    if not obj:IsA("GuiObject") or isOurGui(obj) then
        return
    end

    local name = obj.Name:lower()

    for _, keyword in ipairs(hideKeywords) do
        if name:find(keyword, 1, true) then
            if tracked[obj] then
                return
            end

            tracked[obj] = true
            pcall(function()
                obj.Visible = false
            end)

            obj:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
                if obj.Parent and obj.Visible then
                    pcall(function()
                        obj.Visible = false
                    end)
                end
            end)

            return
        end
    end
end

local function scanGui(container)
    local ok, descendants = pcall(function()
        return container:GetDescendants()
    end)

    if not ok then
        return
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(descendants) do
        inspectElement(obj)
    end

    pcall(function()
        container.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            inspectElement(obj)
            pcall(function()
                for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                    inspectElement(child)
                end
            end)
        end)
    end)
end

scanGui(PlayerGui)
scanGui(CoreGui)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    for obj in pairs(tracked) do
        if not obj.Parent then
            tracked[obj] = nil
        elseif obj.Visible then
            pcall(function()
                obj.Visible = false
            end)
        end
    end
end)

--==================== حلقة الرسم ====================
RunService:BindToRenderStep(
    "CursorManager_Render",
    Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value,
    function(dt)
        if not S.Enabled then
            FC.Visible = false
            return
        end

        local locked =
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter

        if locked then
            pcall(function()
                UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
            end)

            FC.Visible = true
            FC.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)

            if S.Rotate then
                S.Rotation = (S.Rotation + S.Direction * S.Speed * 60 * dt) % 360
                FC.Rotation = S.Rotation
            else
                FC.Rotation = 0
            end
        else
            FC.Visible = false
            pcall(function()
                UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            end)
        end
    end
)

selectCursor(1)
setDirection(1)

print("[CursorMGR] جاهز - " .. #CURSORS .. " مؤشر")
